title: Empire
venue_description:
Empire Burgers and Brew - Naperville's Rustic-Chic Burger Bar and Music Venue

Empire Burgers and Brew represents one of the newest and most popular additions to downtown Naperville's restaurant and nightlife scene. The venue successfully combines quality food with a lively bar atmosphere and consistent live music programming. Located at 48 W Chicago Avenue in the heart of downtown the restaurant and bar attracts locals and visitors seeking a vibrant dining and entertainment experience.

Rustic-Chic Design and Atmosphere

Empire's interior design creates a distinctive rustic-chic atmosphere through industrial-style elements and reclaimed wood accents. The impressive bar serves as the focal point complemented by an eye-catching aesthetic throughout the space. The design successfully balances sophistication with approachability - upscale enough for special occasions yet casual enough for regular visits. Multiple areas within the venue allow for different experiences from intimate dining to bar seating to standing room near the stage.

Weekly Open Mic and Live Music

Tuesday nights feature open mic with sign-ups beginning at 7:30pm. All musicians and musical genres are welcome to perform. The venue provides professional PA system and microphones ensuring quality sound for performers. Beyond Tuesdays Empire hosts live music throughout the week on its dedicated stage. The programming includes local bands solo artists and various musical styles. The combination of open mic accessibility and booked performances creates consistent musical entertainment.

Retractable Rooftop Experience

Empire's retractable rooftop bar distinguishes it from typical indoor-only establishments. The rooftop provides outdoor seating and bar service in pleasant weather creating a completely different atmosphere from the indoor spaces. Guests can enjoy the downtown Naperville streetscape from an elevated perspective. The rooftop has become a signature feature particularly popular during spring and summer months.

Burger-Focused Menu

The menu centers on craft burgers made with quality ingredients. The Gronk burger - featuring double patties cheddar cheese and applewood smoked bacon - has earned particular recognition. Beyond burgers the menu includes appetizers like tater tots and other bar food elevated beyond typical sports bar fare. The kitchen operates during all open hours allowing guests to enjoy full meals whether dining early or eating late after shows.

Extensive Drink Selection

Empire offers a wide selection of beers including many craft options alongside wine and cocktails. The bar program emphasizes quality over quantity with hand-crafted drinks and carefully selected beer taps. Daily happy hour from 5pm to 7pm provides discounted pricing on select drinks. The drink selection and happy hour specials make Empire accessible for regular visits rather than special occasions only.

Downtown Naperville Location

The location at 48 W Chicago Avenue positions Empire in the center of downtown Naperville's commercial and entertainment district. The walkable downtown allows guests to combine dinner or drinks at Empire with other activities - shopping theater or bar-hopping. Parking is available along nearby streets and in public lots. The accessibility and central location contribute to Empire's popularity as a destination and a stop within larger downtown outings.

Hours and Service

Empire operates Monday through Thursday 11am to 1am Friday and Saturday 11am to 2am and Sunday 11am to 10pm. The extended hours accommodate lunch crowds early dinner late-night dining and post-show drinks. Service has generally received positive reviews with staff described as helpful and attentive. The extended hours and consistent service make Empire reliable for various dining and entertainment needs.

Community Reception

Since opening Empire has quickly earned recognition as one of Naperville's hottest restaurants and bars. Reviews consistently praise the atmosphere as the primary draw with the electric vibe and live music creating an experience that transcends ordinary dining. While food quality receives mixed reviews the overall experience - combining good drinks vibrant atmosphere and live music - has made Empire a popular destination for locals and a recognized venue within the broader Chicago suburbs dining and nightlife scene.

Position in Naperville's Music Scene

Empire occupies an important niche in Naperville's live music landscape. While the city has several established music venues including The Venue and various Irish pubs Empire brings a different approach - combining contemporary burger bar atmosphere with consistent music programming. The Tuesday open mic provides accessible entry points for emerging musicians while weekend live music serves established local acts. This combination supports Naperville's growing reputation as a Chicago suburb with quality live music options.
